profile.name: Adeeb Muhammad
profile.bio: A student, an aspiring developer, and someone who spends a little too much time thinking about films.
profile.note: Based in the UAE. Learning C# and Python, experimenting with game development, and following ideas wherever they lead. This is my personal space for the things I make and the stories I keep coming back to.

projects.name: Super Mechs
projects.description: Rebuilding a game I love, one system at a time. A Super Mechs-inspired project in Godot and C#, with modular mech assembly and an early turn-based combat system.
projects.note: Current focus: connecting the pieces into one complete playable battle.

projects.name: AURA
projects.description: Autonomous UAV for Resource & Air-quality Assessment. An environmental-monitoring drone concept exploring how modular sensors could help collect air-quality and atmospheric data.
projects.note: An idea in development, with a focus on environmental monitoring and potential use in the UAE.

projects.name: VAULT.SYS
projects.description: You’re looking at it. A personal portfolio and cinematic archive, built around a simple idea: keep a small corner of the internet that feels like my own.
projects.note: A lightweight static website, with its archive kept in the GitHub repository.
